eligibility.quote: I was just debugging a script for controlling a vehicle and was having trouble with sequencing. And I found that the set_mode service always returns true whether or not the state transtion was accepted.

failed_conditions.quote:
I found that the set_mode service [always returns true](https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/cafb05e79697fc8f1cb889ffac9e5b9d68183460/mavros/src/plugins/sys_status.cpp#L951) whether or not the state transtion was accepted. 

It might fail if the state is invalid but doesn't fail otherwise.

Yes, for some reasons `success` only show mode parsing status ([it may be one from list](https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/cafb05e79697fc8f1cb889ffac9e5b9d68183460/mavros/src/lib/uas_stringify.cpp#L32), or numeric).
Unfortunately there are no reliable method to wait AP response.
